content.comment_body: In [product_name], a 0-10V signal is shown as a range from 0 to 1000 counts when monitoring the program online. If using a temperature sensor that outputs 0-10V for 0-100°C, the system displays a count between 0 and 1000. Is it possible to use an analog block, such as a comparator, to directly display the corresponding temperature in [product_name]? For example, if the count is 1000, can the temperature be shown as 100°C in [product_name]?
Hello, You may find this thread helpful: [url] Best regards, [user_name]

You need to use an analog special function block to display a scaled value, such as an analog comparator or other relevant options. For a setup where 0V corresponds to 0°C and 10V corresponds to 100°C, set the minimum to 0 and the maximum to 100. Alternatively, you can set the maximum to 1000 and adjust decimal places as needed. Experiment with scaling the analog signals, and refer to the online help for [product_name] programming software for more details. Regards, [user_name]
